# New Application Fixture

The project described in this fixture is entirely fictional and fully
anonymized. It contains no confidential information and exists exclusively
for methodological validation of the `project-design` plugin.

## Purpose

Represent the design of a new application with meaningful business,
functional, technical, backlog, and document concerns. The project includes an
MVP and future ideas but no legacy application or migration history.

## Fictional Context

`Kitewood Learning Collective` is a fictional organization. Its proposed
`Learning Opportunities Hub` is a fictional application. Every persona and
project history in the source material is invented.

## Source Artefacts

Provide all of the following files to the skill under test:

- [Business brief](business-brief.md)
- [Stakeholder interviews](stakeholder-interviews.md)
- [Personas](personas.md)
- [Functional expectations](functional-expectations.md)
- [Service rules](service-rules.md)
- [Non-functional requirements](non-functional-requirements.md)
- [Integration notes](integration-notes.md)
- [MVP and roadmap](mvp-and-roadmap.md)
- [Open decisions](open-decisions.md)

This README describes the fixture and is not project source material.

The directory may later accommodate diagrams, detailed specifications,
backlog examples, API documentation, decision logs, and release notes.
